five_question_gate.problem: Does road-observation and scenario conditioning improve direct h1-h3 state/support forecasts from the same frozen analysis state?
five_question_gate.claim_changed: A pass supports conditional short-horizon propagation only; it does not support autonomous transition, road generalisation, hazard or RUL claims.
five_question_gate.cheap_diagnostic: The real c87 no-training compatibility smoke must preserve legacy h1 and execute masks, irregular dt, trigger and maintenance reset.
five_question_gate.minimal_asset: One hash-locked longitudinal synthetic-observation package plus matched scenario table, model registry row and FEM-centred evaluation output.
five_question_gate.registry: Register every run by analysis-package set hash, scenario-table hash, family, seed, parameter count, split and evidence class before training.

blocking_items: Agent1 provides only one c87 observation-state bundle, not a longitudinal training package
Agent2 traffic/environment vectorizer and calibrated road load blocks are not frozen
No independent road section/load trajectory exists for road generalisation
No event/censor diversity exists for hazard/RUL training

exact_inputs_when_unblocked.analysis_states: Agent1 road_observation_state_bundle_v1 packages at every declared observed origin; byte-identical across models
exact_inputs_when_unblocked.observations: independent node/global values and masks; observed_channel_mask is forbidden as measurement availability
exact_inputs_when_unblocked.time_and_scenarios: Agent2 road_time_mapping_v1 load blocks and one frozen traffic/environment/maintenance scenario table
exact_inputs_when_unblocked.physical_reference: FEM eta0 fields at the same origins and horizons; audit only, never a trigger input
exact_inputs_when_unblocked.models: Markov graph, TCN and diagonal SSM with common encoder/decoder/direct heads
exact_inputs_when_unblocked.parameter_match: within 1 percent trainable parameters or report a predeclared matched-width exception
exact_inputs_when_unblocked.budget: same optimizer, update count, early-stop rule and wall-clock cap
exact_inputs_when_unblocked.splits: same observed origins; no repeated windows counted as independent road samples

tasks.post_assimilation: same frozen transition-state package for every model

required_outputs: state_rul_calibration_figures only when corresponding heads are trained
promotion_rules: identical analysis, origin, mask and scenario hashes across families
direct h1-h3 improves FEM-centred field/support metrics without worse transition misses
uncertainty coverage and false-warning/missed-transition rates reported when uncertainty is trained
hazard/RUL remain unavailable unless trained with independent event and censor diversity
synthetic and real rows remain explicitly separated
